content: sqlx (transact-rs/sqlx) SQLite: no built-in reader/writer split (#459 open); maintainers recommend a separate writer pool with max_connections(1); many transactions from one task starve others causing SQLITE_BUSY (#3920); deferred BEGIN cannot be upgraded safely (IMMEDIATE requested #1182/#481); editing an applied migration fails checksum ('previously applied but has been modified', #3794).
